muda.title: Muda: Neuro-Symbolic Timetable Assistant
muda.subtitle: Hybrid-Solving an NP-Hard Combinatorial Challenge
muda.shortDescription: Modeling the university scheduling puzzle in the Congolese context (morning/evening double shifts, shared adjunct faculty, acute classroom shortages).
muda.problemStatement: Universities in the DRC face a complex scheduling problem with multiple, often conflicting constraints, making manual timetable creation prone to errors and inefficiencies.
muda.architectureSolution: A hybrid System 1 / System 2 approach. System 1 (LLM Gemini Flash) interprets natural language constraints and translates them into a structured representation. System 2 (Google OR-Tools CP-SAT) uses this representation to find an optimal solution, ensuring all hard constraints are met.

synoorg.title: Synoorg Ecosystem: NestJS Microservices Architecture
synoorg.subtitle: Distributed Architecture & Tech Leadership
synoorg.shortDescription: Supervision of 3 backend engineers for Synoorg Academy. Modular microservices breakdown under NestJS with Clean Architecture patterns, asynchronous Redis queues, and a partitioned PostgreSQL database.
synoorg.problemStatement: The Synoorg Academy platform required an architecture capable of handling high load, allowing for rapid and independent feature evolution, and ensuring high availability.
synoorg.architectureSolution: A microservices architecture based on NestJS, with asynchronous communication via Redis Streams. Each service is deployed in a Docker container, orchestrated by Kubernetes, ensuring optimal scalability and resilience.
